research.title: Hydrodynamic interaction in Lattice Fokker Planck for dilute polymer dynamics
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend the BGK-type kinetic model for polymer dumbbells and its lattice Boltzmann implementation by incorporating hydrodynamic interaction (HI) effects to accurately recover the slow-variable dynamics governed by the Smoluchowski equation. Unlike Brownian dynamics approaches, which. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: PolyGPT: A Decoder-Only Transformer for Polymer Electrolyte Design
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Designing polymer electrolytes requires control over both material properties and chemical structure. Here, we present PolyGPT, a Transformer with 38.3 million parameters that generates polymer repeat units from optional property targets, requests to include or exclude. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
